nodes.name: Send a text message (Reply to Telegram)

parameters.query:
WITH athlete_data AS (
    SELECT * FROM athletes WHERE telegram_id = '{{ $json.message.from.id }}' LIMIT 1
),
goal_data AS (
    SELECT * FROM goals WHERE athlete_id = (SELECT id FROM athlete_data) AND status = 'Active' LIMIT 1
),
recent_activities AS (
    SELECT sport_type, summary_metrics, start_date 
    FROM activities 
    WHERE athlete_id = (SELECT id FROM athlete_data) AND start_date > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
),
recent_workouts AS (
    SELECT scheduled_date, sport_type, description, status 
    FROM workouts 
    WHERE athlete_id = (SELECT id FROM athlete_data) AND scheduled_date > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
),
chat_history AS (
    SELECT role, content 
    FROM conversations 
    WHERE athlete_id = (SELECT id FROM athlete_data) 
    ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 10
)
SELECT 
    row_to_json(a.*) as athlete,
    row_to_json(g.*) as active_goal,
    (SELECT json_agg(row_to_json(ra.*)) FROM recent_activities ra) as activities,
    (SELECT json_agg(row_to_json(rw.*)) FROM recent_workouts rw) as workouts,
    (SELECT json_agg(row_to_json(ch.*)) FROM chat_history ch) as history
FROM athlete_data a
LEFT JOIN goal_data g ON true;

main.node: Send a text message (Reply to Telegram)
